# Scattered Dad

> Home base for Dan's on-camera channel: a 48-year-old divorced dad with ADHD documenting systems, weight loss and the AI tools that help him focus. Personal experience only; not medical, mental-health or nutrition advice.

Dan's twin daughters head to college in fall 2027. The site lists ADHD-friendly productivity tools (non-medical) sorted by problem, with prices checked on official sites on November 9, 2026, plus copy-paste Grok Bot setups. There are currently no affiliate links or sponsors. Video reviews are coming; tools have not yet been reviewed on camera.

## Pages
- [Scattered Dad: ADHD, divorced-dad life and the tools that keep me on track](https://scattereddad.com/): Dan, 48, divorced dad with an ADHD brain, documenting the rebuild: systems, weight loss and the AI tools that help me focus. Not medical advice.
- [About Dan](https://scattereddad.com/about): Divorced dad, ADHD brain, twin daughters heading to college. What the Scattered Dad channel covers, and what it isn't.
- [Start here](https://scattereddad.com/start-here): New to Scattered Dad? Three steps: meet Dan, try one free tool, get the newsletter.
- [Tools that help me focus (ADHD-friendly planners & apps)](https://scattereddad.com/tools): 13 planners, focus and brain-dump tools sorted by the problem they help with, with prices checked on official sites. Not medical advice.
- [Grok Bot setups for ADHD: 5 copy-paste routines](https://scattereddad.com/grok-bot-for-adhd): Five copy-paste Grok Bot setups for a scattered brain: morning checklist, brain-dump sorter, Sunday review, appointment prep and check-ins. Not medical advice.
- [Videos](https://scattereddad.com/videos): The Scattered Dad channel: tool test-drives, dad logistics, the weight log and Grok Bot setups. First videos coming soon.
- [Newsletter](https://scattereddad.com/newsletter): Get the short version: new videos, what's working and what I quit. No spam, one-click unsubscribe.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://scattereddad.com/affiliate-disclosure): How Scattered Dad makes money, and how paid links and sponsors are labeled.
- [Disclaimer](https://scattereddad.com/disclaimer): Scattered Dad is personal experience, not medical, mental-health or nutrition advice. Weight-loss results are Dan's own.
- [Privacy policy](https://scattereddad.com/privacy): What Scattered Dad collects (your email, if you sign up) and what it doesn't.
- [Terms of use](https://scattereddad.com/terms): The ground rules for using scattereddad.com.

## Tools listed
- Sunsama (https://www.sunsama.com): Daily planner that pulls tasks from your other work tools into one plan for the day, which you then time-block on your calendar. Price: Pro $17/month billed yearly or $22/month billed monthly. Enterprise: contact sales. Free trial with no credit card required; Sunsama says it has no free-forever plan. (checked 2026-11-09)
- Motion (https://www.usemotion.com): AI calendar and project manager that places your tasks into open time on your calendar and reshuffles them when plans change. Price: Pricing page lists Pro AI at $19/month and Business AI at $29/month per seat, with annual billing shown as saving 33%. No free plan listed. (checked 2026-11-09)
- Akiflow (https://akiflow.com): Task and calendar app that collects tasks from email and other apps into one inbox, with quick capture, time blocking and a daily planning routine. Price: Pro $34/month billed monthly or $19/month billed yearly ($228/year). 7-day trial requires a card. No free plan. (checked 2026-11-09)
- Reclaim.ai (https://reclaim.ai): AI calendar assistant for Google and Outlook Calendar that automatically protects focus time, habits and breaks around your meetings. Price: Lite free for one user. Starter $10/seat/month and Business $15/seat/month billed yearly ($12 and $18 billed monthly). Enterprise $22/seat/month, yearly only. (checked 2026-11-09)
- Saner.AI (https://www.saner.ai): AI assistant that brings notes, tasks, email and calendar into one place and suggests what to work on next. Price: Free plan (30 AI messages/month, 100 notes). Starter $8/month; Standard $16/month with unlimited AI messages under a fair-use policy. Pricing page shows 20% off for yearly billing. (checked 2026-11-09)
- Todoist (https://www.todoist.com): To-do list app with natural-language Quick Add, reminders, and Ramble, a voice feature that turns what you say into separate tasks with dates. Price: Beginner free (5 personal projects, limited Ramble sessions). Pro $5/month billed yearly ($60) or $7/month billed monthly. Business $8/user/month yearly or $10 monthly. (checked 2026-11-09)
- Focusmate (https://www.focusmate.com): Virtual coworking: you book a short video session with another person, each say your goal, and work side by side (often called body doubling). Price: Free: 3 sessions per week, no credit card. Plus $8/month billed annually or $12/month billed monthly for unlimited sessions. Business plans available. (checked 2026-11-09)
- Goblin Tools (https://goblin.tools): Collection of small single-task AI tools made mostly for neurodivergent people. Magic ToDo breaks a task into smaller steps; other tools help with tone, time estimates and more. Price: Website tools are free with no ads or paywalls. Mobile apps cost a small one-time price. Optional Goblin Tools Pro subscription for some advanced features (price shown at sign-up). (checked 2026-11-09)
- Tiimo (https://www.tiimoapp.com): Visual daily planner designed for neurodivergent people, with a timeline of your day, a focus timer, to-dos and AI help splitting tasks into subtasks. Price: Free version on iOS and Android (visual planner, focus timer, limited AI features). Tiimo Pro is monthly or yearly; Tiimo says the price varies by location and is shown at checkout. 7-day trial on the yearly plan. (checked 2026-11-09)
- Structured (https://structured.app): Day planner that shows your tasks and calendar events together on a single visual timeline. Price: Free version covers most features with no ads. Structured Pro is monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase; price depends on your region and is shown in the app or app store. (checked 2026-11-09)
- Brain.fm (https://www.brain.fm): Music app with tracks made for focus, relaxation and sleep, sorted by activity such as deep work, light work or learning. Price: $14.99/month billed monthly or $99.99/year. Free trial offered; no free plan found. (checked 2026-11-09)
- Notion (https://www.notion.com): Workspace for notes, documents and databases, with Notion AI and Notion Agent for chat, drafting and autofill. Price: Free $0 (includes a trial of Notion AI). Plus $10/member/month. Business $20/member/month (includes Notion Agent and AI Meeting Notes). Enterprise: custom. (checked 2026-11-09)
- ChatGPT (https://chatgpt.com): OpenAI's AI assistant, with voice chat on web and mobile that you can use to talk through a brain dump and get it back as a list. Price: Free plan available. Paid Go, Plus and Pro plans for individuals (prices shown at checkout). Scheduled tasks are not included on the Free plan. (checked 2026-11-09)
